title: query_dataset: say how many groups existed before the limit cut (totalGroups), as aggregate_records does
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbabAdcWyApSTGBYJNY

Filing category: scope split from #35144 (sub-epic #35159, 问数底座), filed by the seat. #35144's Scope line "The same on `query_dataset` if it lacks it" moves here, so draft PR #35193 can close #35144 on the `aggregate_records` half. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Why

`query_dataset` already takes `order`, `orderBy` and `limit`, and answers `rowCount` and `truncated` (`QueryDatasetOutputSchema`, `packages/spec/src/ai/dataset-tools.zod.ts`). So a cut list is never read as complete. But a client asked "how many X are there" after a top-N cut can't answer: nothing says how many groups existed before the cut. `aggregate_records` answers that with `totalGroups` (on main, and on the hosted tools as "the groups before the cut", cloud `aggregate-cut.ts`). `query_dataset` has no such member.

## Scope

- `QueryDatasetOutputSchema` gains `totalGroups`: the groups before `limit` cut the result, under the same name and meaning as `aggregate_records`. It's additive, so `Clause-②: yes` and a contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.
- It's computed in the database where the dataset executor's driver can. A driver that can't leaves the member out and doesn't build a slower path for parity, the same rule as #35144.
- HTTP and stdio alike. The ask skill's served text gains one line, only if it already teaches `truncated`.

## Done when

- A grouped `query_dataset` with `limit` below the group count answers `truncated: true` and the right `totalGroups`. A call that isn't cut answers `totalGroups` equal to `rowCount`.
- A driver that can't compute it leaves `totalGroups` out, and a pin covers that.
- The pins sit beside the existing `truncated` pins.
